question: Which ailments and toxins are removed by specified recitation counts?
premises: Eye disease is named as a target.
All poison is named as a target.
inference: Recitations counted as four-fours and zero-fives remove eye disease and all poison.
uncertainties: The exact numeric values of vedavedaiḥ and khabāṇaiḥ depend on numerical symbolism conventions.
plain_english: By reciting it forty-four times, eye disease is removed, and by reciting it fifty times, all poison is removed.
